items.title: Amazon S3 Tables with dbt: Iceberg-based data transformations using AWS Glue
items.summary: Amazon S3 Tables, a capability of Amazon S3, bring built-in Apache Iceberg support to object storage. This post shows how to configure and run dbt transformations on S3 Tables with the AWS Glue dbt-glue adapter, using incremental merge and append strategies across a staging and mart architecture.
items.creator: Yukiko Iwazumi
